facts.claim: The Raja of Coorg recovered his hereditary principality from Tippu Sultan without assistance from the Company.
facts.quote: The Raja of Coorg has himself recovered his hereditary principal ity from Tippu Sultan. The Company have in no wise assisted him in this struggle.

facts.claim: The Raja freely opened his country to the Bombay forces and supplied them with grain, cattle, and other provisions.
facts.quote: The Raja freely opened his country to the Bombay forces which marched from Tellicherry to Mysore, and was most zealous in providing the Company's troops with every thing he could procure for them in Coorg and Mysore.

facts.claim: The Raja refused to receive payment for his supplies of grain, cattle, and other provisions.
facts.quote: Of his own accord, the Raja refuses to receive payment for his supplies of grain, cattle, &c.
